The drop rule on line 69 is worded globally, so it is also bypassed for those sections.
  WHY: The reviewers disagree on severity: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT with confidence 3 and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR with confidence 4; the highest is used here. apply-analysis consumes the whole report, so a finding that is already fixed or was previously rejected can come back as a Per-Repo prioritized action or an Executive Summary bullet with no `Finding check:` line, and it can be re-planned.
- prompts/mode-workflow-analysis.txt:69-70 (template lines 62-63) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The drop rule and the "fails open" clause cover only analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md. They do not say what to do when analysis_context.json or the deep-dive log folders (`errors/`, `slow/`, `recent/`) are missing.
  WHY: On a fresh checkout with no `analysis/` directory, the analyst has no concrete repo or run ID to cite in `Finding check: <status> — <evidence>`, so it may fabricate one. The Metrics Appendix `Findings check` row also cannot tell "no input" apart from "all dropped".
